missions.title: First Light
missions.description: You woke up alone in a dead city. Search the district for supplies, then make your way back to the safehouse before night falls.

missions.title: The First Night
missions.description: After dark the city wakes up. Hold the line, clear every wave and make it to dawn. Hiding in the safehouse will not count. Rest at the safehouse door to bring the night on.

objectives.description: Clear every wave and reach dawn

missions.title: Follow the Signal
missions.description: A repeating broadcast leads to St. Mary's Hospital. Find out who is sending it.

objectives.description: Read the page at the entrance

missions.title: The Radio
missions.description: The hospital's emergency radio is in the service alley, but the building has no power. Restore the generator, then take the radio.

missions.title: Into the Dark
missions.description: The radio picked up a second signal from a research site to the south. The creatures are getting faster. Clear another night and learn how they move.

missions.title: The Facility
missions.description: Find the research facility at the south end of the warehouse district and copy whatever data its terminal still holds.

missions.title: The Truth
missions.description: The drive is encrypted, but the safehouse radio can transmit it for decoding. Keep the radio running and clear another night.

objectives.description: Start the transmission at the radio

missions.title: The Butcher
missions.description: The logs name a guardian at the source: the Butcher. He waits in the yard west of the apartments. Go in daylight and bring everything you have. Once the gates close, only one of you leaves.

missions.title: Clear the Streets
missions.description: Every creature you put down is one fewer at your door tomorrow night.

missions.title: Scavenger
missions.description: Workbenches run on scrap. Pick up as much as you can carry.

missions.title: Supply Run
missions.description: The safehouse needs stocking, and the offer expires. Finish it before the end of day 3.
